articles.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
articles.snippet: The AgentCard integration with Visa Intelligent Commerce allows AI agents built on models from any provider, including OpenAI or Anthropic, to effect commercial transactions.

articles.title: Gaming groups urge Congress to ban prediction markets sports betting in CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Gambling industry groups want the US Senate to step in to clarify that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission does not have the authority to oversee prediction markets.

articles.title: Crypto-backed GOP candidate wins Alabama Senate runoff with June primaries looming
articles.snippet: Several more US states are scheduled to hold primaries next week after one Republican candidate won in Alabama on Tuesday after a crypto company-backed PAC used what it called its “biggest spend of the cycle.”

articles.title: Senators Introduce Bipartisan Resolution Opposing SBF Pardon
articles.snippet: Senators Gallego and Lummis want the chamber on record that the FTX fraudster should get no clemency under any circumstances.

articles.title: House, Senate Strike Deal on Housing Bill With CBDC Ban Through 2030
articles.snippet: A bicameral deal on the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act revives a provision barring the Fed from issuing a digital dollar until 2030.
